reviewers.label: gov
reviewers.focus: Data governance and security. PII or sensitive columns (new, renamed, exposed to wider audiences), access grants and row-level security, secrets in profiles/DAGs/env, data residency, retention. CHANGES for any new exposure of personal data without masking or approval.

reviewers.label: contract
reviewers.focus: Contracts with consumers. Schema changes (renamed, dropped or retyped columns), grain changes, changed primary keys, downstream models/dashboards/exports that read the changed tables (check refs and exposures), naming, and documentation in schema.yml. CHANGES for any breaking change without a migration or deprecation note.

reviewers.label: dq
reviewers.focus: Data quality. dbt tests on keys (unique, not_null, relationships), freshness on sources, join fan-out on supposed keys, null and duplicate risk, late-arriving data, timezone handling. Prefer assertions that can be run (row counts, distinct keys). CHANGES when a key column has no test or a join can multiply rows.

reviewers.label: code
reviewers.focus: SQL correctness and cost. Each acceptance criterion is met with evidence; incremental logic and merge keys; idempotent backfills; filter pushdown; scanned bytes and partition pruning; Airflow task dependencies and retries. Run the tests yourself and add the line `Tests: <command> -> <result>`. CHANGES for any bug or unmet criterion.

escalate_on: destructive DDL (DROP, TRUNCATE, column removal) or a full refresh of a large incremental table
a backfill over more than 30 days or a large share of a table
new or newly exposed PII or sensitive columns
changes to tables or views read by external consumers (dashboards, exports, other teams)
new source systems, credentials, or grants
a new dependency (package, dbt package, provider)
